newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen arrests five for July Aden explosions.
newsitem.headline: Yemen arrests five for July Aden explosions.

text.p: Five people have been arrested in connection with several explosions in Yemen's southern port city of Aden last month, the interior minister said in comments published on Wednesday.
Hussein Mohammad Arab, quoted by al-Wahda al-Arabia weekly, said investigations showed the five had planted the bombs which blew up in different parts of Aden on July 28.
"They belong to some Yemeni political parties and admitted in the investigations that they commmitted the crime," the minister said.
Arab did not name the parties. A group of opposition movements has said the authorities arrested scores of their members in connection with the explosions.
Arab said those arrested would soon be put on trial "so that they will receive their just punishment".
